name: [⚡] Steal From Brainrots 🤫
desc:
How many Brainrots can you STEAL? Remember.. Dont anger the Brainrot protecting the base! 😡

1. Take a Brainrot from a base 🤫
2. Escape the Brainrot chasing you 😡
3. Bring them back to your base to earn money 💵
